recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: the ground still humming in venezuela after midnight tremors
aftershocks rippling through hills while cities hold their breath
super-app fortunes turning in southeast asian courtrooms
san francisco fog holding the city at twelve degrees
longest daylight hours before the slow tilt toward autumn
stutter-house pulses under a grey june sky

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Hold to charge a seismic pulse, release to send ripples through a city grid — buildings that resonate in rhythm with your stutter-house beat survive, others crumble into dust.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each pulse lands on the downbeat; nailing three in a row triggers a satisfying bass drop that clears half the screen.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Aftershocks arrive faster, beats get shorter, and off-rhythm pulses crack your own foundations.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe cityscape on fog-grey, pulsing to Fred again.. stutter-house tempo

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag a finger through low-hanging fog to reveal hidden shortcuts — collect glowing agent icons before the fog rolls back in and erases your path.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Uncovering a full shortcut chain from phone to cloud in one swipe feels like cracking a secret level.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Fog thickens, paths fade faster, and phantom duplicates of your trail confuse the route.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor fog layers over a minimalist SF skyline, icons bloom like bioluminescent jellyfish

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort tremor readings into calm, moderate, and urgent lanes as they scroll up — misfiled aftershocks trigger chain reactions that collapse adjacent columns.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Clearing a perfect streak of ten readings unlocks a brief stillness where the screen breathes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Readings blur together, false positives spike, and lanes narrow until only two remain.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper seismograph strips on a muted newsprint palette, ink bleeding at the edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick vinyl records across a yacht-rock sunset deck — match each disc to the correct artist silhouette before it slides off the edge into the ocean.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: A perfect Fleetwood Mac landing spins the deck into golden-hour slow motion for two seconds.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind picks up, records spin faster, silhouettes swap mid-flight, and the deck tilts toward the sea.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: soft-focus 70s album-cover warmth, amber lens flare over overcast Pacific horizon
